crossRefs.note: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.
He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down…
Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to…
“Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them…
Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however Yahweh has shown me that he will surely die.”
Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king…

people.name: Hazael
people.line: King of Aram (Syria), anointed by Elijah.

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “Yahweh has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”
translations.bsb: “But how could your servant, a mere dog, do such a monstrous thing?” said Hazael. And Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Aram.”
translations.kjv: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.
translations.asv: And Hazael said, But what is thy servant, who is but a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, Jehovah hath showed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.
